owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

revokeStore(address).details: Existing lots and their merchant rights remain unchanged, and purchased SBTs stay redeemable.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

createLot(string,string,uint256,uint32,u.notice: Create a new lot. priceUsdc is 6-decimal USDC.

enter(uint256).notice: Free entry into an open lot. One entry per wallet.

promoteWaitlist(uint256,uint32).notice: Promote the next waitlist entry for an expired winner slot.         Anyone can call this after the slot's payment deadline has passed.

purchase(uint256).notice: Winner calls this after approving USDC to this contract.

redeem(uint256,bytes,uint256,uint256).notice: Venue operator submits a ticket holder's signed challenge.         The holder must sign RedemptionChallenge off-chain with their wallet.

requestDraw(uint256).notice: Close entries and request VRF randomness atomically.         msg.value must be >= quoteFee(CALLBACK_GAS) from the coordinator.         Any excess becomes refund credit for msg.sender at the coordinator.

revokeStore(address).notice: Revoke a store from creating new lots.

selectWinners(uint256).notice: Compute winners and waitlist from the stored VRF word.         Callable by anyone once the word has arrived.

setVenueOperator(uint256,address,bool).notice: Set/unset a venue operator for a lot.
